marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind east 25 knots increasing to east 40 late overnight then
diminishing to east 30 early Saturday afternoon. Wind diminishing to east 20
Saturday evening. Scattered flurries tonight and Saturday. Blowing snow
beginning late this evening and ending Saturday evening. Visibility 1 mile or
less in blowing snow. Temperatures near minus 3. Outside the ice edge freezing spray ending Saturday
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 2 to 3 metres subsiding to 1 to 2
Saturday evening.<br/>
